name: Hyatt Ziva Los Cabos
description: All you can eat. All you can drink. All you can do. All, included in your room rate.  Perched on the tip of the Baja California Peninsula, Hyatt Ziva Los Cabos is a luxurious all-inclusive oasis for all-ages. Just up the Pacific Coast, between desert dunes and ocean rock formations, our magnificent beachfront resort offers spectacular views of the Sea of Cortez and is only minutes from San José del Cabo. At Hyatt Ziva Los Cabos, your family will enjoy beautiful suites with sleek décor and private balconies with ocean vistas. Enjoy delectable cuisine at 7 unique restaurants, a pristine beach on the Sea of Cortez and all-inclusive activities for unforgettable family vacations in Los Cabos.

name: Sandos Finisterra All Inclusive
description: Nestled on the mountainside located on Lands End of the Baja California Peninsula, where the sapphire waters of the Pacific Ocean meet the enchanting allure of the Sea of Cortes, lies a haven of dramatic views, unparalleled all-inclusive services, amenities, and natural beauty – Sandos Finisterra. This landmark resort is more than just a place to rest your head; it's an immersive experience that takes you on a journey through the history, heart, and soul of Cabo San Lucas. Whether you're seeking an escape from the ordinary, a romantic retreat, or an adventure-packed vacation, this legendary iconic resort stands as a testament to exceptional hospitality and breathtaking views. Every moment is an opportunity to create unforgettable memories.

Welcome to The Westin Los Cabos Resort Villas - Baja Point
Escape to our Los Cabos beachfront vacation resort
Get away to The Westin Los Cabos Resort Villas Baja Point. Our oceanfront Los Cabos vacation ownership resort places you along the bustling resort corridor where you can immerse in the picturesque beaches and seaside cliffs of Los Cabos, Mexico. Plan to scuba dive amid underwater coral reefs at nearby Cabo Pulmo Marine Preserve or tee off at nearby golf courses. Take a day trip to the famous Los Cabos Arch and after your day of exploring, schedule a revitalizing treatment at our resort’s Spa Otomí or take a swim at our outdoor infinity pool. For our littlest visitors to Mexico, the Westin Family Kids Club sparks a true vacation adventure. Feel recharged after a brisk run or strength training session in our WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio. Dine on-site at any of six restaurants and bars at our Los Cabos holiday resort, offering international cuisines and a sports bar. Relax in your spacious villa or guest room rental with complimentary Wi-Fi. Catch spectacular sunsets at our scenic resort every day of your stay.
No Resort Fees. Free Wi-Fi. Just More to Enjoy.
At The Westin Los Cabos Resort Villas - Baja Point, we keep things simple—no extra resort fees and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout your stay. More value, more comfort, more time to relax.

description:
The Hotel Riu Palace Baja California is located in front of the heavenly El Médano beach, on the south of the Baja California peninsula. This Adults-Only hotel in Cabo San Lucas offers an All-Inclusive 24-hour service, free WiFi, an extensive culinary selection and the best relaxation and entertainment options for you to enjoy an unforgettable holiday at RIU Hotels & Resorts.
The facilities of this All-Inclusive hotel in Cabo San Lucas have everything that you may need. Its over 600 rooms contain a satellite TV, a minibar and beverage dispensers, among many other amenities. And so that you enjoy the warm climate, you have the option of cooling off in one of the four hotel pools, two of which have swim-up bars, or heading to the reserved beach area.
Hotel Riu Palace Baja California offers you a variety of culinary options for you to enjoy exquisite flavours and experiences. The main restaurant offers you authentic American buffet breakfasts with show cooking, while in the rest of the restaurants you can try the best Italian, Japanese and fusion dishes. For a different kind of night, the pool area has a steakhouse for you to savour a delicious dining experience. And don't forget the hotel bars and patisserie with the best snacks and aperitifs. 
Entertainment is a given in this All-Inclusive Adults-Only hotel in Cabo San Lucas, thanks to the line-up of activities and live music and shows. If you’re a tennis fan, you can improve your game for free on the 2 courts at the Hotel Riu Palace Cabo San Lucas. There is also a gym for you to keep up with your favourite exercises and the Renova Spa, a wellbeing centre where you can enjoy the best massages and beauty treatments. Also, as part of the Hotel Riu Santa Fe's facilities, the Splash Water World water park is located a few metres from the hotel, as well as a nightclub for you to enjoy a great night.
And if you're one of those who want to celebrate events or meetings in a special setting, the conference room at Riu Palace Baja California is the ideal space. Here, you’ll receive the best attention from our professionals and have a wide range of services to choose from to make your celebrations truly unforgettable.
In terms of the destination, Los Cabos will astound you with its amazing natural sites, such as El Arco, a rock that is considered the area's landmark. To discover all of its spots, we recommend that you organise a day trip to visit places like the lighthouse at Cabo Falso, Cabo Pulmo National Marine Park or the capital, San José del Cabo. name: ME Cabo Adults Only
description:
A lifestyle resort bursting with personality, where culture meets cool, and where sophistication meets hip. This is the place where the fun never stops, beautifully positioned on the only swimmable beach in Los Cabos, with spectacular views of the famous Cabo San Lucas ‘Arco’.
ME Cabo, a Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star Award, is the definition of paradise. Book one of our modern and exclusive rooms or suites, all with stunning views of the hotel's desert gardens or the deep blue sea of El Médano Beach, and get ready to experience this unique resort first-hand. description:
The Hotel Riu Palace Cabo San Lucas is located on the stunning El Medano beach so that you can experience an unforgettable vacation on the Pacific coast. This 24-hour all-inclusive hotel in Los Cabos has a wide gastronomic offer, the best entertainment and complete facilities for you to enjoy an exclusive RIU hotel in Los Cabos.

Plus, you’ll have direct access to the beach so you can admire the amazing scenery.
The facilities of this 24-hour all-inclusive hotel in Los Cabos have endless services so that all guests can enjoy their stay. name: The Westin Los Cabos Resort Villas & Spa
description: Embrace wellness and adventure at The Westin Los Cabos Resort Villas. Nestled between the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Cortez, our family-friendly vacation ownership resort offers direct access to scenic beaches and dramatic views of seaside cliffs from the heart of Los Cabos, Mexico. Scuba dive amid the coral reefs of Cabo Pulmo Marine Preserve, explore the iconic Los Cabos Arch, or play a round on nearby coastal golf courses. After a day outdoors, playing tennis or at our 24-hour WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio, unwind at Spa Otomí or swim in our infinity pool. The little can have their own vacation fun at the Westin Family Kids Club. Guests of our villas resort can dine at six restaurants and bars serving global and local flavors. Your stylish studio, villa or suite offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a kitchen or kitchenette, a washer/dryer, Westin Heavenly® amenities, and a furnished balcony with ocean views. Discover a rejuvenating stay at our Cabo vacation resort.

name: PARADISUS LOS CABOS-Adults Only
description:
Prepare for an experience unlike any other. Destination Inclusive encompasses all things Los Cabos, with exquisitely crafted cuisine and mixology, local hotel design and guest activities that fully immerse you in the local culture and breathtaking surroundings. For The Reserve guests, Destination Inclusive activities reach well beyond resort borders to further embrace the local essence. Hotel member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
Witness traditional mission-style architecture, works of art and special touches inspired by the local culture. Savor deliciously prepared traditional Mexican cuisine inspired by the sea, prepared with locally sourced ingredients. And enjoy life-enriching activities that reveal the authentic Los Cabos spirit. For The Reserve guests, the experience continues offsite, with private cooking classes with a chef, workshops with local artisans, and a private visit to magical downtown San José and a chocolate factory.

name: Live Aqua Private Residence Los Cabos
description: Luxury and privacy at its finest. Enjoy a sublime pleasure in all your senses in our accommodations at Live Aqua Private Residences Los Cabos. Each residence is decorated in a beautiful contemporary design and provides you with all the comforts of a luxurious home: full kitchen, washer, dryer, and additional facilities and services such as terraces, pools, and hot tubs. Feel the breeze and watch the beauty of the sunsets over the Sea of Cortez while sipping a cocktail at the Sky Bar. Delight in an exquisite dinner at MAI. Refresh yourself with a cold drink by the pool or stroll through the legendary Cabo San Lucas Marina to see the luxurious yachts that are embarked there. As part of Live Aqua Private Residences, you will have access to the countless exclusive facilities and services of our adjoining resort: Grand Fiesta Americana Los Cabos All Inclusive Golf and Spa. Here you can share a round of golf, pamper yourself with a relaxing spa treatment, take a cooking or dance class while the little ones have fun in the Kids Lounge. The most select of Live Aqua belongs to you. It is your space. Live it with absolute freedom.

name: JW Marriott Los Cabos Beach Resort & Spa
description: Experience the essence of tropical luxury at JW Marriott Los Cabos Beach Resort & Spa. Located along the picturesque coastline of San José del Cabo, where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific Ocean, our resort offers the perfect setting to enjoy the sun with a touch of sophistication. Whether you're strolling along the beach, relaxing by our impeccable pools, or perfecting your golf game at the Puerto Los Cabos club and its impressive 27-hole course, disconnecting from your daily routine is easy. Seek respite from the sun and enjoy serenity at our Jasha Spa and Salon. The resort features six distinctive restaurants and bars, ideal for savoring moments from sunrise to sunset. When it's time to rest, find comfort in elegant rooms and suites, with luxury furnishings and inspiring ocean views. Whether you're seeking solitude, a family trip, or rekindling romance, create lasting memories at our Los Cabos resort.

name: Solaz, a Luxury Collection Resort, Los Cabos
description: Experience the epitome of luxury living at The Residences at Solaz. With exquisite, luxurious finishes and unparalleled views these residences offer a truly elevated lifestyle. Enjoy exclusive access to world class amenities and services including a dedicated artisan butler and concierge to ensure every need is met with impeccable attention to detail. Privacy is paramount, allowing you to enjoy the utmost in tranquility and seclusion. Indulge in the finest dining experiences with onsite restaurants where culinary delights await to tantalize your taste buds. Discover a world of incomparable luxury at The Residences at Solaz.

Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Los Cabos is conveniently located between San Jose Del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas, offering easy access to all of the area attractions. This intimate hotel is a great choice for being close to scenic beaches, award-winning golf courses, fishing, surfing plus great shopping and nightlife. Located near the new tollway, our Los Cabos hotel also offers easy access to the airport. Settle into your spacious guest room or suite and enjoy free hot breakfast buffet daily from 7:00am to 10:00am. Each room includes a clean and fresh Hampton bed, free WiFi and refrigerator. Enjoy extra space and amenities in our deluxe rooms with great views and authentic décor. Our Los Cabos hotel is part of the Koral Center that features new ABC hospital, restaurants, shops and more all within one roof for your convenience. Inside the hotel visit our Wellness Center and Spa, unwind in the rooftop pool or whirlpool, and try some intricate cocktail creations in the rooftop Palapa Bar while admiring views of the ocean and mountains. Our friendly staff looks forward to welcoming you with all of the world class service and hospitality.

name: Hilton Los Cabos
description: Iconic yet innovative, classic yet contemporary, Hilton Los Cabos embodies the evolution of the sophisticated resort experience in Cabo San Lucas. Steps away from the Sea of Cortez in the exclusive Los Cabos corridor, along one of the only swimmable beaches in the region, Hilton Los Cabos offers lush, rich surroundings, anticipatory service, and the perfect blend of relaxation and rejuvenation. With expansive views from oceanfront rooms and suites, some featuring private plunge pools, this is a place for guests to discover authentic Mexico, where elevated dining and wellness options are all flavored with local cultural experiences and an international flair. Here, nothing is scripted: From family fun at the Enclave Beach Club to romantic respites in a seaside cabana, energetic events in our gathering spaces to the prime guestrooms and upgraded amenities of AltaMar, you are free to craft your own signature story.

name: Breathless Cabo San Lucas Resort & Spa
description: Breathless Cabo San Lucas Resort & Spa is stunningly situated in the heart of  Cabo San Lucas, only minutes from the excitement, activity and nightlife of the city, on beautiful Medano Beach, the safest swimmable beach in Cabo San Lucas. 169 ultra-contemporary suites with private and scenic  terraces will treat guests to marina and ocean views. Adult singles, couples and friends will indulge in the Unlimited-Luxury® experience, where everything is included: 24-hour room service, pools and beach wait service, unlimited top shelf spirits, daily refreshed mini bar, daily and nightly entertainment, 6 dining venues matched by carefully selected wines and a variety of premium spirits served up at 4 bars and lounges; all without limit, no reservations nor expected gratuities. Breathless Cabo San Lucas offers its guests to enjoy their facilities in case they require a check in before the set time. In the case of check-out, guests can continue enjoying the facilities once they have checked out and before leaving for the airport.

name: Dreams Los Cabos Golf Resort & Spa
description: This luxurious hotel is set directly adjacent to a wonderful, sandy beach, in Los Cabos. It is set overlooking the Gulf of California, and is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Cabo San Lucas can be found just a 15 minutes' walking distance away. San Jose del Cabo can also be found nearby. The international airport is just a 20 minutes' car journey from the hotel. This hotel comprises stunningly-designed suites, which offer a high level of comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to take advantage of the wide variety of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

name: Secrets Puerto Los Cabos Golf & Spa Resort
description: Set in the exclusive community of Puerto Los Cabos, Secrets Puerto Los Cabos Golf & Spa Resort offers adults a stunning Unlimited-Luxury® getaway in Mexico's Baja California Peninsula. The secure community around Secrets Puerto Los Cabos provides striking views of native flora and fauna and miles of unspoiled beachfront of the Sea of Cortez. The resort boasts 500 spacious non-smoking suites each with a private balcony or terrace, 24-hour room service, daily refreshed mini-bar, a Secrets Box for private in-suite dining and more. For added luxury, 150 ocean view suites are reserved for Preferred Club with access to additional privileges including a private lounge, upgraded amenities and mini-bar service, pillow menu, outdoor whirlpool and other extras. Unlimited-Luxury® continues throughout the resort where guests are treated to limitless gourmet fare and top-shelf spirits at elegant restaurants, bars and lounges. 24-hour dining options allow guests to enjoy late night bites at Coco Café. Or stay in and order room service. It's all available at any hour day or night. Indulge in the over 12, 000 sq. ft. Secrets Spa by Pevonia and be treated to spa options in 21 treatment rooms, a full-service beauty salon or an extensive hydrotherapy circuit. Follow up this rejuvenation at the fully equipped fitness center or by taking part in one of many daily and nightly activities. Choose from a variety of beach, land and water activities, take a dip in one of two main heated pools, go on a leisurely walk along the 3 mile stretch of unspoiled Pacific Coast beach or catch the live nightly entertainment. Plus, the Puerto Los Cabos community provides, just steps away, a full service Marina with world-class sport fishing and artisan walkway, and the only composite 18-hole golf course in the area designed by Jack Nicklaus and Greg Norman.

description: Grand Velas Los Cabos Luxury All Inclusive is the only resort on Earth holding the Triple Crown of luxury: AAA Five Diamonds, Forbes Five Stars, and a Michelin-Starred restaurant. Beach hotel located in the tourist corridor between San José del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas. This hotel offers a culinary tour through its 8 gourmet restaurants, offering a variety of specialties such as Italian, Mexican, Asian, steaks and seafood. It's important to mention that Cocina de Autor is a world-class restaurant with a Michelin star distinction, making it an unforgettable experience. Its 307 suites feature 24-hour suite service, a butler, a Jacuzzi, a private balcony, a Nespresso coffee machine, a daily stocked minibar, a safe, Molton Brown bath amenities, bathrobes, and sandals. It's 3 panoramic pools, including one for adults only, a kids club, and a teens club provide a place for relaxation and fun for all ages. Spa services are available at an additional cost, along with a 24-hour gym.

name: One&Only Palmilla
description: The One&Only Palmilla graces the southernmost tip of Baja California, nestled between the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Cortez, a short 20-minute drive from San José del Cabo International Airport. This verdant oasis offers a stunning backdrop where the desert meets the sea, with the azure waters teeming with marine life, including majestic gray whales. The resort captures the gracious style of Old Mexico, featuring red-tiled roofs, whitewashed walls, and exquisite fountains amidst swaying palms and tropical flora. Here, exhilaration and serenity combine to create an unforgettable escape.

description: Perfectly located in the heart of Los Cabos' Tourist Corridor, the newly renovated Zoëtry Casa del Mar Los Cabos is an intimate oceanfront resort with lush gardens, romantic arches and terraces, peaceful courtyards and mesmerizing fountains. Offset by the stunning beauty of colonial hacienda-style architecture - with Adobe walls, red tile roofs and sun-kissed colors - its extensive grounds create an idyllic setting for the ultimate luxury experience for couples, treasured moments with friends or caring for your own well-being. With Endless Privileges®, Zoëtry Casa del Mar indulges guests with limitless access to all services and amenities including 57 luxury accommodations (the majority being suites), four swimming pools, expansive beach, two gourmet à la carte restaurants, two bars, fitness center and a remodeled, full-service luxury spa. With eight nearby championship golf courses, the resort is ideal for golf enthusiasts or those wanting a relaxing vacation by the sea.

name: Corazon Cabo, A Noble House Resort
description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the resort's recreational amenities, including three outdoor swimming pools, two spa tubs, and a sauna. This resort also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. The complimentary beach shuttle makes getting to the surf and sand a breeze. Enjoy international cuisine at Baja Brewing Company, one of the resort's five restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the bar/lounge, the beach bar, or one of the two poolside bars. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Cabo San Lucas? This resort has 10, 000 square feet (929 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and seven meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 305 individually decorated guest rooms, featuring espresso makers and LED televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Medano Beach is a short walk away.

name: Solmar Resort
description: This cosy, traditional Mexican property is nestled on the exclusive Playa Solmar at the southernmost tip of the Baja peninsula where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez. Solmar is just steps from the shopping, dining, and nightlife of downtown Cabo San Lucas and the bustling Cabo Marina. Guests can choose from a variety of guestrooms. Every room features a patio or balcony overlooking the Pacific Ocean. All suites include kitchenettes, satellite television, marble floors, granite countertops, and tiled bathrooms. The three-section pool in the outdoor complex features a large children's area and swim-up cantina, while the adults-only pool provides wave-resistance lap swimming. Other leisure activities include beach volleyball, poker and bingo. Fitness equipment and lighted tennis courts are provided for sports enthusiasts and other water sports are available in the area.

description: The Marina Fiesta Resort & Spa is perfectly situated in the heart of Cabo San Lucas, directly at the marina at only steps away from the famous Medano Beach. Guests can enjoy great dining options and an excellent spa area. The Golden Zone shopping with its designer boutiques and Puerto Paraiso Mall with a wide range of shops and entertainment venues are only seconds away.

name: Hacienda Encantada Resort & Residences
description: Discover paradise high above the sea in a dramatic destination that gives you seclusion, but is still close to the best of the Baja. Ignite your imagination with spectacular views of Land's End, where a rugged coastline greets the Sea of Cortez. Hacienda Encantada brings you the finest Los Cabos luxury experience, pairing exquisite suites and private villas with superior service, traditional Mexican architecture and breathtaking landscapes. Unforgettable memories are waiting to unfold amid the beauty of our family-owned retreat. Guests can receive tour assistance and information at the resort. The Hacienda Encantada Resort also offers a small on site market and a pharmacy. A child's playground area is available as well.

name: Royal Solaris Los Cabos - All Inclusive
description: All-inclusive beachfront resort in San José del Cabo for the whole familyRoyal Solaris Los Cabos – All Inclusive is located on the beautiful beaches of San José del Cabo, just 20 km from Los Cabos International Airport, offering an experience where comfort, hospitality, and entertainment come together in perfect harmony. The hotel features 395 rooms, all with private balconies, equipped with a coffee maker, mini fridge, hairdryer, and carefully selected amenities for a pleasant stay. Its dining offering includes 5 restaurants and 3 bars, with a wide variety ranging from international flavors to gourmet specialties. Highlights include Café Solaris for buffet breakfast and lunch, Rosmarinus for ocean-view lunches, Marco Polo with Italian cuisine, Zai with an oriental menu, and Pancho’s featuring Mexican flavors. In addition, the deli offers coffee, baguettes, and snacks throughout the day. The resort offers multiple activities for all ages, such as beach games, dance classes, and daily entertainment. In the evenings, the atmosphere comes alive with live shows and music in the lobby. For wellness, it features a full-service spa, swimming pools, a children’s water park, and family programs. As a distinctive experience, La Bodeguita restaurant offers an innovative 3D interactive concept (additional cost applies). Every detail is designed to provide a memorable stay in one of the most charming destinations on Mexico’s Pacific coast.

name: Casa Dorada Los Cabos, Resorts & Spa
description: Nestled on Cabo's El Medano beach, this luxurious all-suite resort offers guests a blend of beachside relaxation, spa treatments, and world-class golfing. Just a short distance from Cabo San Lucas Marina and a convenient 30-minute drive from Los Cabos International Airport, the resort boasts 186 elegantly appointed suites, each featuring marble bathrooms with hot tubs and upscale furnishings. Guests can indulge in gourmet dining at Rincon Culinario, enjoy a refreshing dip in one of the swimming pools, or rejuvenate their senses at the Saltwater Spa. A variety of sports and activities cater to those seeking an active vacation. Please note: An environmental sanitation tax of 79. 19 Mexican Pesos (approximately $3. 86 USD) per room, per night will be added to your bill, as mandated by the County of Los Cabos government.

name: Pueblo Bonito Pacifica Golf & Spa Resort
description: Nestled in a paradisiacal and peaceful beach in Cabo San Lucas in Mexico, this luxurious and lovely resort is the best holiday destination for all those travellers who wish to disconnect from the every day's troubles and find the total self-renewal state. All the luxuriously appointed and elegantly furnished guest rooms feature breath-taking views over the ocean and all conceivable amenities for an unforgettable stay. All the accommodation units are nicely decorated with plush furniture and boast a chic and cosy look that will help its guests to feel completely at ease. Guests will have the opportunity to sample exquisite dining specialities at the five excellent on-site restaurants. Travellers will be able to unwind and relax at the fantastic spa and health centre and corporate guests may wish to make good use of the meeting and conference spaces available on-site.

name: Pueblo Bonito Los Cabos Blanco
description: The holiday village is located on the western side of the tip of the Baja California Peninsula, overlooking the Pacific Ocean and a wide expanse of pristine private beaches. The holiday village is 40 minutes from San Jose International Airport and 10 minutes from the centre of Cabo San Lucas. The holiday village is composed of villas with the stunning architecture style of a Mexican hacienda, housing beautifully decorated suites, all with fabulous ocean views. The holiday village also features a spectacular collection of art from the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. The grounds are dotted with lush gardens, waterfalls and lovely fountains, which create an inviting oasis in a setting of great natural beauty.

name: Club Regina Los Cabos managed by Accor
description: Club Regina Los Cabos is a unique beachfront resort, built on the side of a cliff. It is located in the corridor between San Jose del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas and every room offers gorgeous views of the Sea of Cortez. Known by the many repeat guests for its friendly and accommodating multi-lingual team, the resort has repeatedly been awarded TripAdvisor's Certicate of Excellence. The orange adobe exteriors of the buildings perfectly complement the rugged desert terrain. Offering two restaurants, a coffee shop, several bars, a market, four swimming pools, daily activities, concierge and car rental service, guests find plenty to enjoy during their stay.

description: This hotel is located on Paseo Malecon, in Los Cabos. It is situated amidst the exclusive Tourist Corridor, lying within easy access of a wealth of attractions in the area. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the historical downtown area, the Theatre, San Municipal Palace and the legendary San Jose Mission, many shopping centres, Government offices and the business areas of San Jose del Cabo can be found close by. This wonderful hotel welcomes visitors with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms offer comfort and style, in a peaceful setting. Guests will be pleased by the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

name: Playa Grande Resort & Grand Spa
description: The hotel is located on a beautiful beach close to all sections of the famous Arco. The large building rises directly above the golden sands of Solmar Beach in Cabo San Lucas. The comfortable beach resort offers a total of 358 beautiful guestrooms and sumptuous suites. Guests may select from charming deluxe junior suites, spacious and elegant master suites or one of the 2 spectacular penthouse suites. All accommodation units are designed to provide visitors with maximum comfort through contemporary amenities and useful commodities, while retaining the traditional allure of the Mexican architectural culture.

name: Villa La Valencia Beach Resort & Spa Los Cabos
description:
When you stay at Villa La Valencia Beach Resort & Spa Los Cabos in San Jose del Cabo, you'll be on the beach, within a 15-minute walk of Desert Park Natural Reserve and Cuadra San Francisco. This 4. 5-star resort is 11. 3 mi (18. 2 km) from Medano Beach and 3. 9 mi (6. 3 km) from Chileno Beach. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 5 outdoor swimming pools and a lazy river. This resort also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free valet parking is available onsite. All-inclusive rates are available at this resort. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy American cuisine at Latitud 23. 5, one of the resort's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 5 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Make yourself at home in one of the 304 air-conditioned rooms featuring microwaves and Smart televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries.

name: Mar del Cabo By Velas Resort
description: Mar del Cabo by Velas Resorts is a European-style hotel for those 16 and older, ideal for travelers seeking relaxation, adventure, or a romantic getaway. The pool and beach area are perfect for enjoying the ocean breeze, a ceviche, and a cocktail. American breakfast is included in the Encanto restaurant, which offers a fresh and organic menu inspired by local flavors. The suites will captivate you with their unique style, featuring a kitchenette equipped with amenities such as a coffee maker, kettle, refrigerator, microwave, and toaster upon request, as well as bathroom amenities, a safe and a hairdryer, among others. Please note that guests receive a 20% discount at Grand Velas Los Cabos for dinner restaurants specializing in Italian-Mediterranean, Mexican, fine steaks, seafood, and Asian fusion dishes. Reservations are required.

name: GR Solaris Lighthouse
description: Contemporary luxury facing the Sea of CortezGR Solaris Lighthouse – All Inclusive is an elegant retreat overlooking the Sea of Cortez, where contemporary luxury blends with spectacular views and an atmosphere of total relaxation. The resort features 5 outdoor swimming pools with stunning ocean views, creating ideal settings for rest and leisure. Its rooms, spacious and bright, include a private balcony, satellite TV, wooden furnishings, and high-quality amenities that ensure comfort and sophistication. The dining experience is varied and refined. Tavo stands out as a modern sushi restaurant, alongside options featuring Mexican, Italian, and international cuisine. The main restaurants serve breakfast and lunch, while the bars invite guests to enjoy a relaxed yet elegant atmosphere. Room service is available for an additional charge. Located just 5 minutes from the historic center of San José del Cabo, next to a golf course and approximately 20 km from Los Cabos International Airport, the resort enjoys a privileged location. GR Solaris Lighthouse is the ideal setting to enjoy an all-inclusive experience where gastronomy, comfort, and the natural beauty of the destination come together perfectly.

name: Park Royal Homestay Los Cabos
description: Nestled within a golf course, Park Royal Los Cabos offers guests a tranquil escape with easy access to both San Jose del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas. This resort features spacious suites, two outdoor swimming pools, hot tubs, a restaurant and bar, a coffee shop, and room service. Guests can also enjoy a children's splash pool and the convenience of a nearby store. The surrounding area boasts world-class golf courses, stunning beaches, and a variety of exciting tours.

name: Bahia Hotel & Beach House
description: The hotel offers guests a chic, modern retreat. Set in a pedestrian-friendly community, the urban setting allows guests an unprecedented opportunity to enjoy walks to every location while also taking advantage of the hotel's privacy and service. Relax by the pool and sip handcrafted cocktails. The Cabo experience is much more than a hotel stay. Much of the hotel experience is about being anywhere but here – whether up a mountain, into the desert or out to sea. The hotel's team sincerely invested in helping guests experience the best of Baja: to see every species, sample every flavour and explore every exhilarating opportunity. The property has it all: close proximity to the Sea of Cortez's most swimmable stretch of shoreline, first-rate food, and Cabo's icons – as well as endless excellent excuses to get away from it all. A 15-minute cab ride from the airport and 1 block from the sand and surf, the hotel puts guests within easy reach of all Cabo San Lucas can offer. Designer shops and lively nightspots are a short walk away, and Medano Beach is a 2-mile (3. 2-km) stretch of clubs, cafés, and spas.

name: Grand Solmar Lands End Resort & Spa
description: When voices are found, there's amazement over the location impossibly situated between cliff and sea. Pelicans soaring over golden sands and sailboats scooting across blue waves. Infinity edge pools with swim-up dining. White-canvassed cabanas complete with poolside massages. And a seasoned staff who wait, hands folded, for the next opportunity to serve. Thoughtfulness and thoroughness are the trademarks of the Grand Solmar. Every detail was considered right down to the intricate designs in the walkways, the stone entries to the rooms and the subterranean passages for the staff. This is an exciting new property, an elevated standard of luxury and an undeniable chance to be left speechless.

name: El Encanto All Inclusive Resort
description: This sophisticated Hotel is set in Cabo San Lucas. There are a total of 62 rooms on the premises. This establishment was established in 2016. Be Charmed by an Idyllic Coastal GetawayEvery moment is a sensory adventure. Infused with traditional hacienda style and genuine Mexican hospitality, our all-inclusive resort immerses you in the essence of Los Cabos. Villas and suites are lavishly designed with a fresh Baja aesthetic. Embark on an ancient healing journey at our holistic spa. Savor creative cuisine with ice-cold cocktails in eight unique restaurants and poolside bars. Indulge in 24-hour room service. Live your dream. Feel the enchantment. Become part of the magic of Cabo San Lucas.

name: Posada Real Los Cabos
description: The Posada Real, with its charming contemporary Mexican style, low-rise structure, and tranquil cactus gardens, blends seamlessly with the rugged beauty of the Baja Peninsula. Located near several Los Cabos golf courses and the new Puerto Los Cabos marina, this hotel offers various accommodation plans, from European Plan to All-Inclusive. The All-Inclusive option includes breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and select domestic drinks from 11:00 am to 10:30 pm. The hotel's 152 standard rooms feature air conditioning, telephones, satellite TV, coffee makers, clock radios, hairdryers, in-room safes, and private balconies or terraces. Guests can enjoy multiple dining options, including the Cactus Restaurant, the Wahoo Taco Snack Bar, El Dorado Lobby Bar, El Oasis Pool Bar, and room service. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, a travel agency, business center, car rental, gym, massage area, a meeting room, and on-call physician. Guests can also partake in activities such as golf, surfing, and scuba diving.

name: Villa La Estancia Beach Resort & Spa, Los Cabos
description: A delightful five star resort nestled on the scenic Médano Beach, the best swimming beach in the city, with exquisite views of El Arco and Land's End and within walking distance to downtown. This Spanish-colonial masterpiece offers 156 suites, fine dining, luxurious amenities and an indulgent spa designed to enrapture your senses.

name: Hotel Tesoro Los Cabos
description: Nestled in the heart of Cabo San Lucas Marina, this hotel offers unparalleled access to the vibrant tourist scene. Its prime location on the Cabo Marina Boardwalk places you steps away from Land's End Arch and a plethora of bars, nightclubs, and restaurants. The renovated rooms provide a welcome respite after a day of exploration, and many boast stunning marina views showcasing magical sunrises and breathtaking sunsets. Guests can choose from various dining experiences, including a breakfast buffet and diverse menus featuring Italian, Mexican, and seafood cuisine. Hotel amenities include a rooftop SkyPool, a gym with panoramic marina views, three restaurants, two bars, a swim-up bar, an espresso bar, a business center, and free parking. Cabo San Lucas International Airport is 9 km away.

name: The Ridge At Playa Grande
description: The Ridge at Playa Grande offers a choice of one-bedroom Master Villas, two-bedroom Luxury Villas, and unique three-bedroom Presidential Ultra Luxury Villas. Each villa features a well-equipped kitchen, spacious living room, full-size baths, and upscale finishing touches, including flat-screen TVs, internet service, premium-quality linens, and all the privacy you desire. Beyond your villa, enjoy an adult pool with a swim-up bar and poolside service, tennis courts, a fitness center, and a hot tub. Or, step into the private world of our luxurious spa and let us pamper you with attentive service and revitalizing treatments. For an unforgettable dining experience, the casually elegant Ridge Restaurant awaits. Our award-winning chef specializes in Mediterranean cuisine, serving delicious fare for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name: Holiday Inn Express Cabo San Lucas
description: Holiday Inn Express Cabo San Lucas is strategically located at the entrance of the main town. We may not be located right on the beach, however, we are only a 15 minute drive from the nearest public beach We are located at the foot of the Transpeninsular Highway, on which it is very easy to get to the main beaches of the destination, as well as San Jose del Cabo, Todos Santos and La Paz. We are a 10 minute drive from “La Marina” where you can find various restaurants and bars. It is the heart of Cabo's nightlife fun. It is also the starting point for a wide variety of boating, diving and fishing activities. Enjoy a complimentary and delicious breakfast in the mornings and stay in shape with complimentary access for our guests to the best Gym “Cabo Fitness Club. Relax in our outdoor pool with an exceptional view of the famous rock formation “El Arco de Cabo San Lucas”, also known as Land's End.

name: Medano Hotel and Spa
description: Situated in Cabo San Lucas in the Baja California Sur Region, 700 metres from Marina Cabo San Lucas, Medano Hotel and Suites boasts an outdoor pool and fitness centre. Medano Hotel and Suites features free WiFi throughout the property. You will find a coffee machine in the room and a flat-screen TV in each room. They all include a private bathroom fitted with a shower. Certain rooms include a seating area where you can relax. You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property. The hotel also offers car hire. El Arco is 2.1 km from Medano Hotel and Suites, while Los Cabos Corridor is 14 km from the property. The nearest airport is Los Cabos International Airport, 35 km from Medano Hotel and Suites. Medano Hotel and Suites also features: Médano Hotel & Suites now features Pickleball Courts Mini Golf Course Croquet Game Pool Bar Outdoor Heated Pool Meeting space

name: Los Patios
description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at El Tabachin, a poolside family restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the poolside bar. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 76 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies or patios.

name: Sunrock Hotel & Suites "Los Cabos"
description: Sunrock Condo Hotel is the answer to your search for the best hotels in Los Cabos, Mexico. Come to Cabo San Lucas and rest in a real paradise! Sunrock Hotel is a suite with 80 2 bedroom suites overlooking the arch of Cabo San Lucas, 7 swimming pools, gym and more 5 minutes from the Convention Center and the Marina of Cabo San Lucas and very close to the city center, from The beach, bars, restaurants and the vibrant night life of Cabo.Sunrock Condo Hotel is the 3 star hotel with affordable prices and a family and business atmosphere that will allow you to stay with us, whatever your reason for your trip to Los Cabos, at any time of the year. Please consider that guest will pay mandatory at his arrival a hotel fee and local sanitation tax

name: City Plus By Marriott Cabo San Lucas
description: Located in the Colonia El Progreso area of Cabo San Lucas, City Express Plus by Marriott Cabo San Lucas is within a 15-minute drive of Diamante Golf Courses and Cabo del Sol Golf. This hotel is 10. 3 miles (16. 6 km) from Chileno Beach. Enjoy recreational opportunities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. The hotel also offers complimentary wireless internet access and a vending machine. Make yourself at home in one of the 135 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. You can enjoy a meal at the Family restaurant, or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel also offers conference space and a meeting room. Free self-parking is available onsite.

name: Punta Pescadero Paradise
description: The charming beach hotel is located in the town of Los Barriles, in a privileged and magical place known as East Cape, on the southern Baja California peninsula. Nearby places of interest include the Cactus Sanctuary (75 km away), San Jose del Cabo (96 km away), La Paz (114 km away), Los Cabos (126 km away) and Todos Santos (150 km away). The family-friendly historical hotel offers exclusivity, luxury and a private environment ideal for a restful holiday. The air-conditioned eco hotel offers 23 rooms in total and welcomes guests in a lobby with a 24-hour check-out service, a hotel safe and cloakroom. Further facilities include a games room, TV lounge, bar, and a breakfast/dining room. Guests may also take advantage of the WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services, a car park and a bicycle hire service. The themed hotel also offers wonderful views of the Pacific Ocean. The club resort has modern rooms, which are fully equipped with an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer, as well as a double or king-size bed, and a terrace with ocean views. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio and hifi, Internet access, a safe, mini fridge, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and individually regulated air conditioning. There are two outdoor swimming pools with a children's swimming area and a poolside snack bar with parasols. Guests may also relax with a massage and enjoy a game of tennis, table tennis, volleyball or beach volleyball. Guests may also enjoy water sports, such as jet skiing, waterskiing, diving, motor boating and pedal boating, or visit cave paintings. The hotel offers entertainment programmes for adults and children. Parasols are provided on the nearby sandy, pebble and rocky beaches.

name: Tropicana Los Cabos, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
description: Located in the historic heart of San Jose del Cabo, this hotel is just 20 minutes from the international airport, a short stroll from the downtown area, and 1. 5 km from the beach. It offers 70 rooms, each with a private bathroom (shower, bathtub, and hairdryer), direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, internet access, and adjustable air conditioning. Guests can enjoy two on-site restaurants serving à la carte and set menus, a pool bar, Jacuzzi, and a wellness center. Additional amenities include 24-hour reception, a safe, Wi-Fi, room service, laundry service (extra charge), and parking. Relax poolside under umbrellas at the beach bar or indulge in a massage (extra charge).

name: Grand Solmar Pacific Dunes Resort Golf and Spa
description: Nestled between sapphire seas and dramatic desert landscapes, Grand Solmar Pacific Dunes is a destination like no other. Enjoy endless views and gentle sea breezes from our infinity pool, swim-up bar and secluded beach. Relax in a spacious suite with an ocean view terrace and spa bathroom. Discover tranquility in our spa where ancient rituals revitalize the senses. Comfortably hidden away within the exclusive private resort community, just north of bustling Cabo San Lucas, this luxury resort is above and beyond ordinary. Savor the flavor of Baja at restaurants and bars with cuisine crafted from fresh, local ingredients. Celebrate your destination wedding or other special event in our elegant indoor and outdoor venues. This is not just a vacation. This is Grand Solmar Pacific Dunes. Discover your own private paradise.

name: Vista Encantada Spa Resort Residences
description: A stay at Vista Encantada Spa Resort & Residences places you in the heart of Cabo San Lucas, a short drive from Cabo del Sol Golf and just minutes from Santa Maria Beach. This 4-star resort is also convenient to Chileno Beach and Medano Beach. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Take a dip in one of the two outdoor swimming pools or spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a picnic area. The resort features a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, the resort offers 4827 square feet of space, including a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available (surcharge applies), and free valet parking is provided. All-inclusive rates are available and cover meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may apply for select restaurants, special dinners, dishes, beverages, and other amenities. Enjoy dining at one of the resort's two restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafÃ©. Unwind with a refreshing drink at the poolside bar or one of the two bars/lounges. A complimentary local cuisine breakfast is served daily. Make yourself at home in one of the 37 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops, private patios, and 50-inch plasma televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi and conveniences such as phones, safes, and separate sitting areas are also provided.

name: Hotel El Ganzo
description: This luxurious boutique hotel, a member of Preferred Boutique, offers elegant rooms and spacious suites overlooking the Sea of Cortez. Located at the base of the Marina Puerto Los Cabos, it's a short 20-minute drive from the international airport and just five minutes from historic San Jose. Blending historic beauty with modern delights, this hotel provides an unmatched entertainment experience ideal for adventurous, artistic, and cultural travelers.

name: Todos Santos Boutique Hotel
description: THE ART OF LUXURY ACCOMMODATIONNestled in the heart of the old town, Todos Santos Boutique Hotel is a hidden gem that redefines the art of luxury accommodation. This intimate ten-key boutique hotel is a true testament to meticulous craftsmanship, with everything designed with super-fine attention to detail. Stepping inside feels like stepping into a vibrant canvas, thanks to the hand-painted murals that adorn the walls, each telling a story of its own. What makes this place even more enchanting is its rich history; once owned by a Spanish countess, it exudes a timeless charm that's impossible to resist.

name: Hacienda Beach Club & Residences
description: With a stay at Hacienda Beach Club & Residences in Cabo San Lucas (El Medano Ejidal), you'll be steps from Medano Beach and San Lucas Bay. This 5-star aparthotel is 1. 9 mi (3 km) from Marina Cabo San Lucas and 2. 5 mi (4. 1 km) from The Arch. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. Additional features at this Colonial aparthotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare (surcharge). Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite. Satisfy your appetite with Mexican cuisine at Hacienda Cocina y Cantina, a beachfront restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/café. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the beach bar or the poolside bar. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. Wired and wireless Internet access is complimentary, and LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature jetted bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name: Four Seasons Resort Los Cabos At Costa Palmas
description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After practicing your swing on the golf course, you can dip into one of the 7 outdoor swimming pools. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite to eat at one of the hotel's 8 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the 2 coffee shops/cafes. Wind down with a drink at one of the 4 bars/lounges or 2 poolside bars. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in La Ribera? This hotel has 5856 square feet (544 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 141 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers.

name: Montage Los Cabos
description: Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. Montage Los Cabos provides 24-hour reception. This establishment's common areas are disability-friendly. Corporate travellers may avail for event rooms, ideal to host a business seminar or a special occasion. There is no time to get bored at this hotel thanks to the entertainment options on offer.

name: Las Ventanas al Paraiso
description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find outdoor tennis courts, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional features at this resort include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Grab a bite at The Restaurant, one of the resort's 5 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this resort consist of a conference center and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

name: Grand Velas Boutique Hotel Los Cabos
description: Grand Velas Boutique is a luxury adults-only hotel in the Los Cabos Tourist Corridor, just 35 minutes from Los Cabos International Airport. Its 79 splendid suites offer unique services for an unforgettable stay, including a butler, a welcome bottle of wine and mezcal, 24-hour room service, a Nespresso Vertuo coffee machine, a daily-stocked minibar, a Jacuzzi, a vitamin C shower, Molton Brown toiletries, and a Dyson hair dryer & straightener (upon request). Delight in exquisite culinary creations at its 3 on-site restaurants or enjoy access to the 7 restaurants at its sister hotel, Gran Velas Los Cabos, where the experience is elevated to the highest level by the Michelin-starred Signature Cuisine. Relaxation spaces and incredible views from its infinity pool, gym, and spa (additional charge) where you will find massage rooms overlooking the ocean.

name: Chileno Bay Resort & Residences
description: Nestled along a protected cove and the tranquil waters of Chileno Bay and created with a distinct vision to embrace the natural beauty and capture the inspiring sense of adventure quintessential to Los Cabos. Presenting a new way to experience the very best of Baja. A 20 minute drive from Los Cabos International Airport -SJD- and a 20 minute drive from downtown Los Cabos. Chileno Bay Resort is located halfway between Los Cabos and San Jose del Cabo. Chileno Bay Resort and Residences is nestled on the pristine shores of Chileno Bay a tranquil cove that is sheltered from the areas typically strong surf. Set across 22-acres the beachfront resort is designed with a modern aesthetic and an open-air layout to capture the beauty of our natural surroundings and inspire and enrich our guests. Dining outlets present a fresh take on local favorites while the Spa offers the ultimate wellness retreat infused with the warmth and spirit of the local culture.

name: Esperanza, an Auberge Resort
description: The property is located 4mi SW of Cabo San Lucas Mexico perched on a bluff overlooking the Sea of Cortez. This highly acclaimed luxury resort overlooking the Sea of Cortez offers an incomparable natural setting on 17 lush beachfront acres with a beautiful view of Cabo San Lucas famous Lands End. The 57 ocean view casitas and suites and 60 luxurious villas managed by Auberge Resorts offer the ultimate oceanside retreat. Resort amenities include personal concierge service - award-winning spa - oceanfront dining - beachfront infinity pool - private beach with service - fitness programs and recreational pursuits.
